'**Action** - {r}, destroy this: Put an arrow from your hand face-up into your arsenal. It gets +1{p} this turn. **Go again**' (Ranger Equipment - Arms). Battleworn is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately not authored.

ACTIVATION SHAPE per the gauntlet_of_might draft precedent (same 'Action - destroy this' equipment skeleton): card-level activation_cost 1 carries the {r} (never also PAY_RESOURCES - double-charge); 'destroy this' is the ability-level DESTROY_SELF cost, paid before ON_ACTIVATE dispatch. ACTIVATE timing (action phase + action point) matches the printed '**Action** -'; _add_hero_dsl_activations offers it from the arms zone (play.py:262-265).

GO AGAIN authored as GAIN keyword GO_AGAIN: GoAgain is NOT in printed_keywords, so this is an ability-granted keyword, not a printed one; _grant_go_again pays +1 AP directly outside combat.

RELEASE NOTE ('may activate even with no arrow in hand'): LOOK_AT with a filter stores a possibly-empty list; SELECT_FROM_REF min 0 offers STOP immediately and stores [] on an empty pool; MOVE_REF/FLIP_REF no-op on an empty ref. GAIN GO_AGAIN is unconditional, so the action point is still gained - exactly the note's ruling.

+1{p} CLAUSE: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queued only when an arrow was actually chosen (effect-level REF_EXISTS gate evaluated in-order at execution, interpreter.py:149-159), filtered to Arrow attacks, expires end of turn = printed 'this turn'. KNOWN IMPRECISION: the queue binds to the NEXT arrow attack, not to the specific card put into the arsenal - if another arrow attacks first this turn it takes the buff instead. No ref-bound attack-mod primitive exists; flagged rather than guessed around.

SET FOLDER AT ADOPTION: HighSeas -> json/highseas/.
